en.hubeali:
And from him, from his father, from the one who narrated it, from Abdul Rahman Al Azramy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘

The one who mentioned Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic during a meal, or drink, at the beginning of it, and Praises Allah<sup>azwj</sup> during its end, would not be Questioned about that Bounty of the meal, ever!’
en.sarwar: 14. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from his father from those who narrated to him from ‘Abd al-Rahman al-‘Arzamiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘
One who mentions the name of Allah on food or drink at the beginning and ‘All praise belongs to Allah’ at the end, he will never be asked about the blessings of the food.’”
